skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental business management principles in agriculture.
Develop strategic plans for agricultural businesses.
Apply financial management techniques in agricultural contexts.
Implement marketing strategies for agricultural products.
Identify and manage risks in agricultural operations.
Analyze environmental factors affecting agricultural businesses.
Optimize supply chain processes in agricultural industries.
Manage and develop brands in agricultural sectors.
Apply problem-solving techniques to real-world agricultural challenges.
Enhance communication skills through group discussions and presentations.
